import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0131 {α : Type _} {A B : Set α} (h : Finite A) (hB : Finite B) : 
  card (A \ B) = card A - card (A ∩ B) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0131 {α : Type _} {A B : Set α} (h : Finite A) (hB : Finite B) : 
  card (A \ B) = card A - card (A ∩ B) := by
  have hAB : Finite (A ∩ B) := by
    rw [Finite.inter]
    exact hB
  have hABc : Finite (A \ B) := by
    rw [Finite.diff]
    exact h
    exact hAB
  have hABc_card : card (A \ B) = card A - card (A ∩ B) := by
    rw [Finite.card_diff h hAB]
  exact hABc_card
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0131 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0131 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0131
